$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for research. Context7 serves up-to-date, version-correct library docs (the repo's context7.json points at the matching Context7 space). Runs keyless out of the box; for private libraries or higher rate limits add "--api-key", "${CONTEXT7_API_KEY}" to args and set CONTEXT7_API_KEY (get a ctx7sk- key at https://context7.com/dashboard). Requires outbound network access to registry.npmjs.org and context7.com.
